name: io.github.trahloff/aldine
title: Aldine
description: Self-hosted collaborative LaTeX editor: read and edit files, typeset, get the errors and the PDF.

headers.name: X-Aldine-Token
headers.description: Public demo token: aldine-demo. The demo is a shared sandbox, wiped nightly at 04:00 UTC.

aldine_host.description: Host of your Aldine instance (ALDINE_PUBLIC_URL without https://), started with ALDINE_MCP=1

headers.name: X-Aldine-Token
headers.description: ALDINE_MCP_TOKEN when auth is off, or a personal access token (aldn_...). Omit it to use the Connect (OAuth) flow when AUTH_ENABLED=1.
